H1 followed by H2 creates a nested group under the H1

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"include_document_structure\":true}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<h1>Chapter One</h1><p>Chapter intro.</p><h2>Section One</h2><p>Section content.</p>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
